scope: Only declared planning obligations; actual source interfaces remain open until source/receiver review

crosscut_obligations.name: 配置与内容版本
crosscut_obligations.required_question: 当前使用哪个配置/数据集？只是有数据，还是确实被载入并消费？

crosscut_obligations.name: 时间、步数与随机
crosscut_obligations.required_question: 暂停/离线/读档/地图变化是否推进？随机分支是否有可复核输入条件？

crosscut_obligations.name: 生物所有权与存放
crosscut_obligations.required_question: 获得结果会不会丢失或重复？满容量/取消时哪些状态已经提交？

crosscut_obligations.name: 永久状态与临时战斗状态
crosscut_obligations.required_question: 哪些跨战斗保留？何时还原、清除、恢复持有物/等级？

crosscut_obligations.name: 成长与触发时序
crosscut_obligations.required_question: 经验、学习、进化、孵化、获得记录的前后顺序是否一致？

crosscut_obligations.name: 资源与交易一致性
crosscut_obligations.required_question: 失败/取消是否消耗、发奖或部分完成？上下限如何处理？

crosscut_obligations.name: 文本、UX 与错误
crosscut_obligations.required_question: 同一拒绝条件在不同入口是否有不同反馈？UI 文件隐藏了哪些状态变化？

crosscut_obligations.name: 扩展与工具兼容
crosscut_obligations.required_question: 插件/编译/编辑是否改变数据与调用顺序？哪些只是作者工作流要求？

crosscut_obligations.name: demo 和宿主材料
crosscut_obligations.required_question: 能否找到事件调用、参数和前置？缺失资源会让哪些结论无法验证？

junction_checkpoints.name: 生物—队伍—储存
junction_checkpoints.requirements: identity/ownership, capacity, persistence and legal member moves; entry-specific failure prefixes

junction_checkpoints.name: 战斗中成长—学习反馈
junction_checkpoints.requirements: growth primary rules, trigger/wait, ongoing battle ability/move changes, abandon choices and consistency

junction_checkpoints.name: 捕获—战斗—图鉴
junction_checkpoints.requirements: unique capture formula, forced reception/cancel permissions, growth/registration/storage ordering
